references.text: The explanation for why the chief priests wanted to kill Lazarus: because many Jews believed in Jesus on account of him, and thus they turned away from the Pharisees.
Mark recounts a similar conspiracy where the chief priests and scribes planned to arrest and kill Jesus, parallel to their plans against Lazarus.
The chief priests and scribes are looking for a way to destroy Jesus but fear the crowd, a dynamic that also underlies the decision to kill Lazarus in secret.
Caiaphas and the chief priests discuss the strategy that it is better for one man to die for the people, a logic that is extended to include Lazarus in chapter 12.
